title: Early Canadian Society: Backwoods Settlement
prompt: Read the paragraph below carefully. Then write ONE sentence that shows you understand the main idea.

config.text: Life in the backwoods of Upper Canada was hard and isolating. Settlers had to clear dense forest before they could plant crops or build homes. Families often lived far apart, so neighbors relied on working bees — community events where people gathered to help each other raise barns, clear stumps, or harvest crops. These working bees were not just practical; they were also social events with food, music, and storytelling. For many settlers, the working bee was the only time they saw other families for weeks. This combination of difficult physical labor and strong community bonds defined backwoods life in early Canada.
